source: Usage Report: unused keys, and used keys that are not defined, sorted by key. "x18n: Delete Unused Keys" (the trash icon of the view) lists what it would delete and asks first. The edit lands in the open editors, so you can undo it before you save.
text: 使用處報告：未使用的鍵，以及已使用但未定義的鍵，依鍵排序。「x18n: Delete Unused Keys」（檢視的垃圾桶圖示）會先列出將刪除的內容並詢問確認。變更會套用在已開啟的編輯器中，因此你可以在儲存前復原。
